exposure: duration of the second stage of labor
outcome: duration of second stage of labor
correlation between AoP and HPD with maternal-fetal characteristics
cohort: 82 women in the second stage of labor
finding: Low parity and high HPD were found to be significant predictors of cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: The mean duration of the second stage of labor differed between vaginal and cesarean deliveries (65.3 vs. 160 min; p-value < 0.001) and between cesarean and operative vaginal deliveries (160 vs. 88.6 min; p-value = 0.015).
